data.desc: At Amylyx, our purpose is guided by an unwavering commitment to the communities we serve as we discover and advance novel therapies for debilitating diseases and conditions with high, often underrecognized, unmet medical needs. Our approach is not limited to any single condition, disease, or modality and is rooted in understanding the underlying biological drivers to advance meaningful progress in how diseases and conditions are understood and treated. We are currently focused on endocrine conditions and neurodegenerative diseases where we believe we can make the greatest impact.
